approval.comparison: Exact single approval message after trimming outer whitespace; no extra words.
approval.frozen_file_repair: NEVER; new policy version and receipt required

source_authority.timestamp: NATIVE_PTS only; no derived FPS fallback
source_authority.bounds: intersection of conservative [lo,hi) source indices and [start_s,end_s) native times
source_authority.observation_link: exact source-frame index and selected local candidate only; do not match derived observation timestamps or interpolate
source_authority.legacy_F_ids: private verified F-to-S map, never full-rate GT citation IDs

coordinate_system.display_conversion: invert actual scale and letterbox; validate raw pixel bounds

citations.candidate_backed: Nonempty verified selected observation IDs at exact authorized index; visual association still required.
citations.direct_visual_only: No existing selected observation at this frame, IDs empty, what/where description required; no machine association or track extension.
citations.confirmed_association: SUPPORTED on all event evidence and known state support
citations.role_semantics: BEFORE before event, AFTER after event, TRANSITION inside bracket, STATE direct support at cited frame, COVERAGE assessability only
citations.unmodeled_observations: free text plus frame IDs and citations; never confirmed event types

temporal_rules.exact_requires: TRANSITION, equal start/end native time at a cited transition, strict earlier BEFORE and later AFTER
temporal_rules.bounded_and_uncertain: latest BEFORE to earliest AFTER; no interpolated midpoint; strictly ordered
temporal_rules.multiple_events: unique IDs and event records; sort by start,end,event ID
temporal_rules.overlapping_uncertain_brackets: require chronology_uncertainty=true for involved events; report, do not impose false precision
temporal_rules.definite_contradictions: reject contradictory opposite exact transitions at same instant/frame and incompatible observed before/after states
temporal_rules.before_after_states: Optional if observed. Before-state frame <= latest BEFORE; after-state frame >= earliest AFTER. Evidence includes asserted frame. Unknown/null does not establish a transition; OTHER requires description and support.

outcome_rules.no_event: first frame + middle-third frame + last frame COVERAGE citations and THROUGHOUT_ASSESSABLE declaration; no unobservable target/transition gaps
outcome_rules.target_not_observable: No positively supported target-visible citation/state anywhere; ambiguous/limited visibility uses INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
outcome_rules.confirmed_exhaustiveness: Not implicit; only validated EXHAUSTIVE_ATTESTED confirmed-event windows are exhaustive for the two-event ontology.

last_confirmed_rules.state: latest directly supported known physical state, not assumed final frame or persisted state; STATE_UNKNOWN can support directly visible location without asserting support
last_confirmed_rules.no_frame: null timestamp/location/marker, empty state/location evidence, subsequent UNKNOWN
last_confirmed_rules.location: description/GUI marker require same-frame SUPPORTED STATE evidence and frame ID in location evidence
last_confirmed_rules.window_end_visibility: last authorized native frame, independent state axis
last_confirmed_rules.subsequent: UNKNOWN unless strictly later supported direct in-window location; never a guaranteed current location
last_confirmed_rules.unknown_or_unobserved_afterward: human declaration for the remainder of reviewed window; no extension beyond window

eligibility.primary_denominator: Originally eligible, valid, uncompromised and NOT_DEPENDENT only

deduplication.item_id: PT2A_ plus first 16 hex SHA256 of serialized key; collision check
deduplication.retain: all original pack IDs, overlap groups, source/media/local provenance and eligibility; dedup identical media regardless of trigger

references.selection: exact original-seed first, binding if present, last strictly pre-window; dedup ascending; verify source pixels and hash

storage.timestamps: real backend UTC at save, automatically recorded
storage.invalid_or_leaked_records: preserve separately and exclude, never silently repair

repeat_review.subset_rule: sort SHA256(seed + item_id), ties by item_id; first max(1,ceil(N/4)) if N>0 else zero; frozen before responses

sampling.candidate_stride_frames: user-supplied positive integers only; no default chosen
sampling.index_grid: authorized full-rate positions j, window-relative; j%k==o for every o in range(k)
sampling.evidence_spans: inclusive earliest..latest cited BEFORE and AFTER positional envelopes
sampling.result: per offset both-role hits, misses, all-offset boolean
sampling.short_interval: end_position-start_position < k; native PTS duration also reported
sampling.limitation: Envelope intersection is not visual informativeness, model accuracy, or GT-guided model frame selection

future_model_contract.model_pre_window_references: TBD in Phase2b preregistration; disclose human use

limits: single annotator likely same as Phase1c
identity/event circularity self-declared, not independently verified
event-expected sampling with no negative controls
minimal event ontology and unmodeled gaps
human visual correctness/authorship not cryptographically proven

revision.changes: Version/approval metadata plus confirmed-only event-list completeness and dependent evaluation/enforcement specifications. All other V1 behavior unchanged.

exhaustive_coverage.citations: First authorized frame, middle-third frame, last authorized frame, SUPPORTED COVERAGE with frame IDs; exact native time/kind rules unchanged.

non_exhaustive_uncertainty.description: Explicit gap, incompleteness or unknown event-list completeness; no event-specific uncertainty change.

event_list_exhaustiveness.strict_no_confirmed_event_semantics: UNCHANGED; no redundant completeness or negative-attestation field
event_list_exhaustiveness.timing_imprecision_of_supported_event: Not alone a hidden-event gap; no blanket rejection of bounded/timing-uncertain supported events.

event_evaluation.scope: Two-event ontology; exploratory DEV evidence support only, not formal eligibility or scoring implementation.
event_evaluation.completeness_gate: Validated EXHAUSTIVE_ATTESTED CONFIRMED_EVENTS or validated strict NO_CONFIRMED_EVENT only.
event_evaluation.primary_additional_gate: NOT_DEPENDENT only; other dependence strata separate sensitivity analyses
event_evaluation.non_exhaustive_unlisted_events: UNEVALUATED; never exhaustive negatives or automatic FP/hallucination
event_evaluation.non_exhaustive_positives: Separately reported exploratory supported-event matching/qualitative analysis if otherwise eligible and validated.

planned_v2_enforcement.gui: Confirmed-only three-value selector, no default; four unchecked explicit statements; coverage/assessability gate; explicit gap uncertainty; omit stale completeness fields on outcome change.
planned_v2_enforcement.semantic_validator: Schema plus native coverage membership, full assessability/known-gap consistency and every inherited validity/exclusion gate. No machine proof of human visual truth.
planned_v2_enforcement.report: Exhaustiveness values, exclusion reasons, original seed/dependence strata and windows/non-overlap groups/source files separately; never unlisted-event negatives.
test_specification: full coverage/assessability and both citation kinds
possible gaps exclude exhaustive; timing imprecision alone does not
unchanged strict no-event and no redundant other-outcome fields
partial positives separate; unlisted predictions not false by default
